result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make empathy involuntary and non-selective.

Not niceness. Not agreement. Just the inability to experience another person as less real than yourself. You could still hate, compete, be wrong, fail each other. But you couldn’t quietly erase someone into a category—enemy, statistic, noise, deserving, disposable.

Most of the world’s worst machinery runs on that little erasure. I’d remove the switch.
